native.iec61162_part: Actual61162 part: one-way serial1/2, NMEA2000/CAN3, Ethernet450 or450+460 safety/security. No default part chosen by industry.
native.iec61162_edition: Actual specification edition/amendments; old serial/electrical or multicast tables do not silently certify2024 revisions.
native.iec61162_device_profile: Actual device/firmware qualified profile versus generic device requiring its own verified interoperability.
native.iec61162_role: Actual port/network role. Serial port has one talker or listener direction; CAN nodes and IP participants differ.
native.iec61162_transport: Actual selected part transport; TCP binary option is separate from UDP multicast and CAN PGNs.
native.iec61162_content: Actual ASCII sentence, binary PGN, or general binary transfer; a PGN inside450 remains encapsulated IP traffic.
native.iec61162_device_source: Actual manufacturer/firmware capabilities, listener/talker/PGN services and accepted settings.
native.iec61162_edition_source: Actual applicable edition/amendments and normative interoperability tables.
native.iec61162_binding_source: Actual canonical port/segment and registered lower transport/physical path, independently from industry.
native.iec61162_encoding_source: Actual sentence/PGN/binary/tag/quality/encoding layout, not generic payload8 or65535.
native.iec61162_serial_conformance_source: Actual selected-edition serial timing/electrical/sentence conformance; a legacy device table does not prove2024.
native.iec61162_nmea_source: Actual applicable NMEA package, PGN services/address claim/fast-packet/physical certification and SOLAS additions.
native.iec61162_baud_bps: Actual serial clock;4800/38400 literature proposals are part-qualified, not a family-wide rate or Ethernet throughput.
native.iec61162_data_bits: Actual8-bit serial character with D7=0 for documented legacy8N1 profile; actual newer-edition encoding evidence required.
native.iec61162_parity: Actual serial parity. Documented FA150 IEC profile uses no parity.
native.iec61162_stop_bits: Actual1/2 stop bits; documented FA150 profile uses1.
native.iec61162_character_bits: Actual serial start/data/parity/stop bits per byte; documented8N1 uses10, not8.
native.iec61162_talker_count: Actual talkers per one-way serial segment, exactly one; listeners never arbitrate as CAN nodes.
native.iec61162_listener_count: Actual attached listeners; electrical loading/installation determines accepted number.
native.iec61162_input_impedance_ohms: Actual device/installation input_impedance_ohms; specified tolerance/bound is not a fabricated operating default.
native.iec61162_threshold_v: Actual device/installation threshold_v; specified tolerance/bound is not a fabricated operating default.
native.iec61162_max_pin_voltage_v: Actual device/installation max_pin_voltage_v; specified tolerance/bound is not a fabricated operating default.

native.iec61162_clock_error_ppm: Actual device/installation clock_error_ppm; specified tolerance/bound is not a fabricated operating default.
native.iec61162_isolated: Actual listener isolation present and tested; no assumed optocoupler from device name.
native.iec61162_sentence_inner_chars: Actual ASCII characters between start delimiter and CRLF; documented untagged limit79, not whole-wire79.
native.iec61162_sentence_wire_bytes: Actual untagged sentence wire octets:1 start+inner characters+2 CRLF, maximum82.
native.iec61162_can_bitrate_bps: Actual NMEA2000 classic-CAN clock250kbit/s for part3; not CANFD data phase nor Ethernet.
native.iec61162_can_binding: Actual independently registered NMEA2000/CAN ports/segment; physical/arbitration/PGN evidence belongs to that path.
native.iec61162_can_fd: Actual part3 baseline uses classic CAN, not CANFD.
native.iec61162_physical_nodes: Actual NMEA2000 physical device count;50 limit differs from logical addresses.
native.iec61162_pgn_identity: Actual PGN and its supported specification/device definition; addressing/services separate from Ethernet group.
native.iec61162_pgn_transport: Actual single classic-CAN frame, Fast Packet, or explicitly verified multipacket service.
native.iec61162_pgn_payload_bytes: Actual PGN encoded payload. Fast Packet223 bound differs from single CAN frame8 and actual other transport.
native.iec61162_fast_packet_frames: Actual Fast Packet frame count with its own sequence/length overhead. Source summary says31 frames for223 bytes; exact first-frame/counter layout needs applicable NMEA specification before imposing a frame-count bound.
native.iec61162_ethernet_binding: Actual independently registered Ethernet/IP transport path;61162 has no universal Ethernet rate.
native.iec61162_ethernet_bitrate_bps: Actual bound link bitrate;100BASE_TX named-device proposal does not become a family-wide clock.
native.iec61162_sfi: Actual unique system function identifier and collision checks; no invented SFI or talker identity.
native.iec61162_multicast_address: Actual group address for chosen edition/device/content; PGN/CAN address is separate.
native.iec61162_destination_port: Actual UDP group or binary TCP destination; manufacturer ranges differ by profile and message class.
native.iec61162_group_index: Actual group code/index per matching device/edition mapping; cannot turn binary or syslog group into a sentence.
native.iec61162_group_name: Actual transmission-group semantic identity. TGTD/MISC are different device defaults, not universal group assignment.
native.iec61162_datagram_header: Actual documented UDP sentence UdPbC or retransmittable binary RrUdP envelope; prefix wire layout must be evidenced.
native.iec61162_envelope_bytes: Actual complete encoded IEC61162 envelope bytes;5 printable header letters do not prove full wire header size.
native.iec61162_tag_block_bytes: Actual complete tag-block bytes including separators/checksum; not a universal zero.
native.iec61162_sentence_bytes: Actual encapsulated encoded sentence octets, including relevant delimiters/terminators.
native.iec61162_binary_block_bytes: Actual binary application block, separate from fragments/datagrams/TCP stream.
native.iec61162_datagram_bytes: Actual total UDP payload with selected sentence/binary/PGN envelope/tags.
native.iec61162_peer_datagram_limit: Actual peer accepted UDP payload, not generic MTU1500 or65535.
native.iec61162_fragment_count: Actual encoded fragment count and reassembly deadline, never inferred from application bytes alone.
native.iec61162_igmp_version: Actual host membership protocol version; VR7000 documents1, that does not prove460 switch conformance.
native.iec61162_igmp_snooping: Actual switch multicast filtering where required by selected edition, separately from host IGMP version.
native.iec61162_authentication_tag: Actual2018+ authentication-tag use/security agreement; no silent security guarantee.
native.iec61162_base_450_edition: Actual underlying450 edition for460 add-on;460:2024 references450:2024.
native.iec61162_secure_zone_isolated: Actual secure/non-secure boundary isolation through approved460 forwarder.
native.iec61162_redundancy: Actual approved redundant460 network topology and failover evidence.
native.iec61162_sfi_collision_detection: Actual monitoring detects SFI collisions for applicable edition.
native.iec61162_network_monitoring: Actual monitoring/alerts present and verified for applicable460 system.
native.payload_bytes: Actual application encoding for selected part; serial inner79/wire82, classicCAN8/FastPacket223 and IP/binary fragment layouts differ. No global1500 or65535 maximum/default.
